title: Characterization of valid graph encodings
statement: For every bit string $x$, let $u$ and $v$ be the first and second components returned by parsing $x$ as a self-delimiting pair, using the empty word for a component when parsing fails. Then $x$ equals the encoding formed from a word of $|u|$ ones and the adjacency matrix decoded from $v$ (with missing matrix entries read as false) if and only if $x$ is the pair encoding of a word of $|u|$ ones and $v$, and $|u|^2=|v|$.
